body: Cycle-2 material delta: official Android contracts support Presentation on app-visible presentation displays; Android 16/API 36 now allows built-in displays in DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION; API 34+ AccessibilityService can attach an accessibility-overlay SurfaceControl directly to a specified logical display. These are platform capabilities, not Fold7 proof: simultaneous inner+cover exposure/illumination and secondary-digitizer routing remain OEM/runtime evidence-gated. Public raw MotionEvent display attribution is not assumed; Cycle 3 will use receiving-root display context + InputDevice metadata with privacy-safe logging.
